thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — want to lock owners and timelines for the action items: quota guardrails, scheduler tuning, headroom staffing. I'll publish updates to the postmortem doc once we confirm. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/gpu-2025-02-28

yusuf: I can own quota guardrails. Plan: add per-tenant soft limits + alerting, and a safe fallback policy. Will open a PR and a ticket today. ETA end of week.

ops-bot: New ticket created: RDW-3421 "Quota soft limits and fallback" assigned to yusuf.

linda: Scheduler tuning here — I can run the initial tuning pass and perf tests on staging. Need ~2 weeks to validate changes across seq lengths. Will coordinate with @devon for canary run.

devon: Happy to help with canary + monitoring hooks. Suggest adding a trace tag on canary traffic: `x-redwood-trace: headroom-test`. Also will add a canary dashboard.

sam: Headroom staffing note — ops oncall bandwidth was a big factor. Propose a temporary rotational guard overnight and a clearer escalation play. CC: @sre-lead.

sre-lead: Agree on both. I'll draft a staffing schedule, update the runbook, and add an automated headroom alert: "GPU free capacity < 12% for >5m" to page the oncall.

jen: For alert rule, can reuse existing k8s metrics + exporter. Quick example: `expr: (gpu_free_bytes / gpu_total_bytes) < 0.12` with `for: 5m`. We should also alert on sustained queue length increase.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action summary I'm recording now in the tracker: yusuf -> quota soft limits (ETA 2025-03-05), linda -> scheduler tuning + perf tests (ETA 2025-03-19), devon -> canary + trace/dashboard (ETA 2025-03-12), sre-lead -> staffing schedule + alert (ETA 2025-03-10), sam -> ops rota proposal (ETA 2025-03-10). I'll add acceptance criteria and link tickets.

yusuf: :thumbsup: I'll add acceptance criteria: no increase in 5xxs during controlled quota changes; throttle rate < 0.5% after rollout; automated rollback if error rate spikes.

linda: Note to self — we need to replay the exact spike patterns from 2025-02-28 in staging. I'll commit the test scripts and dataset by Friday.

devon: Starting the canary job on a dedicated pool tomorrow morning, will post logs to the canary dashboard.

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up meeting scheduled 2025-03-11 15:00 UTC (channel: #incidents).

maria: If anyone needs to shift ETAs, update the action tracker before EOD Friday so we can keep the postmortem tidy. Thanks all.
